note.value:
Initial Setup: Choose a college for your Wizard.

Casting Spells: Roll above casting value to cast a spell. May reroll casting attempt if Wizard's college.

Dispelling Spells: Roll above the casting value of the dispelling card. May reroll dispel attempt if Wizard's college.

End Phase: Remove lingering spells. If not clinging to wreckage, discard cards then replenish hand.
